neighbours.label: Fires on a plural count noun right after a numeral that counts it (sacked 217 generals, deployed in 15 operations), not on the same nouns without a number or with a vague quantifier.
fire: By the end of the season the club had fired 14 coaches in a row.
Last year the charity ran 320 schools across the region.
The archive now holds 9,000 letters from the war years.
In the census of 1901 the town listed 87 churches and chapels.
The firm has opened 42 offices since it was founded.
Officials said 260 soldiers were wounded in the attack.
Inspectors visited 58 factories during the spring campaign.
The navy lost 23 ships before the treaty was signed.
quiet: By the end of the season the club had fired its coach again.
Last year the charity ran several schools across the region.
The archive now holds letters from the war years.
In the census the town listed its churches and chapels.
The firm has opened new offices since it was founded.
Officials said many soldiers were wounded in the attack.
Inspectors visited the factories during the spring campaign.
The navy lost ships before the treaty was signed.

predictions: Fire 0.3-0.55, median ~0.4. Near misses (no numeral, 'several', 'many') <= 0.1. AUROC ~0.95.
notes: Probes: '15 operations' 0.52; '40 million cases' 0.44 (peak ' million'); 'over 700 institutions' 0.43; 'dismissed 217 generals' 0.38; lows: 'The generals met' 0.02, 'Several cases were reported' 0.02; '$46 million contract' 0.13; 'The battle lasted' 0.15. Fire items avoid 'million' so the peak lands on the noun.
